title: Server Virtualization (VMware) and Lab 01
src: Source: Lecture 08 Server Virtualization (45 slides). The Lab 01 walkthrough is in the Lab 01 tab.
lead: Lecture 08: why servers are virtualized, hosted vs hypervisor, full / para / hardware-assisted virtualization, Hyper-V, Xen, KVM, LXC, Proxmox, VT-x, EPT / RVI, VT-d, VMware products, ESXi vs vSphere, vCenter, vMotion and Storage vMotion step by step, DRS, HA, SRM, ESX networking, vSwitches, Nexus 1000V. Lab 01: create a VM on ESXi and set a static IP with nmcli.
